constraints.definition: CHECK ((((work_before IS NULL) AND (work_after IS NULL) AND (transition_verb IS NULL)) OR ((work_before IS NOT NULL) AND (work_after IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(work_before) = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(work_after) = 'object'::text) AND (work_before ?& ARRAY['status'::text, 'version'::text, 'responsible_ref'::text, 'accountable_ref'::text, 'waiting_on_ref'::text, 'attributes'::text]) AND (work_after ?& ARRAY['status'::text, 'version'::text, 'responsible_ref'::text, 'accountable_ref'::text, 'waiting_on_ref'::text, 'attributes'::text]) AND (transition_verb IS NOT NULL))))

functions.name: learn_work_history_immutable
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_work_history_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if old.work_before is not null or (tg_op='UPDATE' and new.work_before is not null) then
    raise exception 'Structured work history is append-only';
  end if;
  return case when tg_op='DELETE' then old else new end;
end $function$

functions.name: learn_work_snapshot
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_work_snapshot(p intelligence_objects)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object('status',p.status,'version',p.version,
    'responsible_ref',p.responsible_ref,'accountable_ref',p.accountable_ref,
    'waiting_on_ref',p.waiting_on_ref,'attributes',p.attributes);
$function$
